200.description: Current persisted run snapshot. A failed execution is still a successful retrieval.

schema.description: Persisted agent run snapshot with a request ID for support correlation.

run.description: Current persisted snapshot of the requested agent run.

run_id.description: ID of the run, preserved across approval continuations.

agent_id.description: ID of the agent that owns the run.

state.description: Current lifecycle state of the run.
state.title: PlatformAgentRunState

created_at.description: Timestamp when the run was first persisted.

updated_at.description: Latest persisted activity timestamp across the execution and its messages, including checkpoint messages. This is not a worker heartbeat or an exact state-transition timestamp.

expires_at.description: Execution deadline, when one is set. Not the run history retention deadline.

pending_interactions.description: Unanswered tool approvals when the run is in REQUIRES_INPUT. Empty in other states.

items.description: Pending approval for a specific persisted tool invocation and its arguments.

interaction_id.description: Identifies this specific invocation approval, not the tool definition.

type.description: Interaction type identifying a tool execution approval request.

tool_id.description: Platform tool identifier when recorded. Omitted for requests without one, such as some MCP tools.

display_name.description: Display name of the tool requesting approval.

description.description: Description of the tool associated with this approval request.

arguments.description: Arguments from the persisted approval request. Older platform tools use flattened parameters.

expires_at.description: Approval deadline, when one is set. Omitted when the approval has no expiration.

items.title: PlatformAgentRunToolApproval

output.description: Accumulated text-only agent output under the messages key, when available.

error.description: Caller-safe failure details when the run is in FAILED.
error.title: PlatformAgentRunError

run.title: PlatformDurableAgentRun

request_id.description: Platform-generated request ID for support correlation.

schema.title: PlatformAgentRunResponse

400.description: Invalid request (malformed JSON, invalid parameter values, unknown fields).

schema.description: Error response following RFC 9457, extended with `code` and `documentation_url` for machine-readable classification and self-service remediation.

title.description: Short, human-readable summary of the error.

status.description: HTTP status code mirrored from the response.

detail.description: Human-readable explanation specific to this occurrence.
detail.example: The provided cursor has expired. Start a new search to get a fresh cursor.

documentation_url.description: Direct URL to documentation for this error code.

request_id.description: Platform-generated request ID for support correlation.

errors.description: Field-level validation problems, one entry per offending field.

items.description: Field-level validation problem for a single offending field.

pointer.description: RFC 6901 JSON Pointer to the offending field.

detail.example: Must be one of: USER, GLEAN_AI.

items.title: PlatformProblemDetailError
